activeForm: Implementing route handler for PATCH /api/users/:id with complete middleware chain
description: Implement user.routes.ts with PATCH /api/users/:id endpoint. Integrates authentication middleware (JWT validation), authorization middleware (profile ownership check), validation middleware (Zod schema), and controller from T2.2. Write 15 MVP-tier tests (integration tests for middleware chain execution, E2E tests for complete HTTP flow). This subtask completes the full PATCH /api/users/:id feature.
